subject.title: fix(acpx): keep leaked non-openai model out of the Codex ACP thinking slot

question: Should this PR land with the additive modelExplicit/appliedModel ACP runtime contract and the Codex ACP policy of dropping inherited unsupported defaults while failing explicit unsupported selections?
rationale: The source review found no concrete patch defect, but the PR changes compatibility-sensitive provider/model routing and expands the ACP runtime boundary, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept provenance contract
options.body: Land with modelExplicit and appliedModel as the intended boundary because the patch separates inherited defaults from caller intent and prevents first-turn replay of dropped models.

options.title: Document behavior before merge
options.body: Ask for release-note or PR-body wording that unsupported explicit Codex ACP model selections now fail while inherited non-OpenAI defaults are dropped.

options.title: Pause for narrower API
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers do not want generic ACP runtime fields for model provenance and prefer a Codex-only contract shape.

recommendation.title: Accept provenance contract
recommendation.body: Land with modelExplicit and appliedModel as the intended boundary because the patch separates inherited defaults from caller intent and prevents first-turn replay of dropped models.
